objective: Determine whether a run may be treated as safely completed after a dispatched write has an unknown post-state.
claim: The write completed and the session may continue normally.

facts.selector: halts when a managed file tool explicitly reports an unknown post-state
facts.observation: The production loop records an unresolved pending effect and returns toolExecutionUnknown.
An unknown file receipt is persisted as unknown and stops the run before a final answer.
